messages:
nina: Nightingale sent a new onboarding bundle for their open model. Key asks: allow redistributed quantized weights to HW partners, let SIs rehost in managed clouds, and coordinate a joint announcement. Spot any hard stops?

sofia: Quick read  legal red flags: unclear sublicensing language, missing export/ECCN info, and attribution requirements are vague. Recommend we limit downstream resale and require export compliance.

aj: Eng note: need explicit supported quant formats and whether format conversions are permitted. This affects our packaging and runtime detection.

liam: Product: marketplace bundles ok if contract requires version pinning, rollback, and a metadata header for auto-detect. Also require a tiny compatibility test to avoid bad conversions.

maria: Marketing needs a 10-business-day embargo lead, single approved quote, and logo usage list. Also which channels are allowed?

oliver: (Nightingale) theyre comfortable with rehosting so long as model behavior isn't altered. Prefer permissive license but open to reseller rider that preserves attribution.

sofia: @oliver could you confirm whether "not altered" allows fine-tuning? If not, that blocks many SI workflows.

oliver: will check with counsel. Preliminary: fine-tuning allowed; commercial re-offerings need notification and revenue share discussion for large resellers.

nina: Can Eng draft a redistribution snippet and list of formats we intend to support? Want to avoid rework.

aj: I'll drop an appendix: SupportedFormats: [q4_0, q4_1, q8_0]; Conversions allowed if metadata and checksums retained; no structural edits.

sofia: Draft legal line to propose: "Distributor may redistribute model binaries in quantized/optimized forms provided original attribution is retained, redistributions do not create derivative models for resale without express written permission, and all parties comply with export laws." Anyone object?

liam: Add requirement for a small semantic regression test suite (we host) to validate redistributed weights before marketplace listing.

maria: Also add a 24-48 hour review window for co-branded assets.

counsel-bot: Reminder: attach NDA and export assessment template: https://redwood.internal/legal/nda-export-template (automated)

nina: Proposed timeline: legal redline by Wed EOD, Eng appendix by Thu, partner counsel confirmation by Fri, joint announcement sync next Mon. Is that realistic?

oliver: I'll push counsel tonight; Friday confirmation may be tight but possible.

sofia: I'll queue redlines and highlight reseller language.

aj: Appendix draft will be in the shared doc in ~3h.

maria: I'll prepare marketing checklist and embargo calendar entry.

nina: Thanks team. Next update here Friday 16:00 PT.
